title: My skills and goals

prepTasks.word: One day I will be able to...

writingModel: My name is Kamila Seitkali and I am a second-year student at WKU. In this text, I want to write about what I can do, what I cannot do yet, and my goals for the future. I think it is important to know your strengths and to always work on your weaknesses.

I can do several things well. First, I can speak three languages: Kazakh, Russian, and English. Speaking three languages is very useful for my studies and my future career. Second, I can play the dombra — a traditional Kazakh instrument. I learned it at the age of eight. I can play about twenty traditional songs now. Third, I can write code in Python at a basic level. I started learning it online six months ago.

However, there are things I cannot do yet. I cannot drive a car — I am saving money for driving lessons. I cannot cook well — my soup always tastes terrible! I also cannot draw well. My drawings look like something a child made. These are my weaknesses, but I am working on them every day.

My best friend at WKU is Amir. He can do things that I cannot do. He can build websites, fix computers, and solve a Rubik's cube in two minutes. He cannot play any musical instruments and he cannot cook either — we have that weakness in common! But he is the most talented programmer I know.

My goals for this year are clear: I want to learn to drive, I want to improve my cooking, and I want to speak English more fluently. I am learning to drive every Saturday morning. I watch cooking videos online every evening. And I speak English every day at university. I believe that if you practise every day, you can achieve anything. One day, I will be able to say: "I can do everything I wanted to do!"
